    10 Dân pits · 2 Quan pits · Quan = 10 pointsTraditional Vietnamese strategy game

    How to play

    1. Choose a small pit on your side that contains pebbles, then choose clockwise or counter-clockwise.
    2. Sow one pebble at a time into each next pit, including the Quan pits. If the pit after your last drop is an occupied small pit, pick up its pebbles and keep sowing.
    3. Capture across a gap: if the next pit is an empty small pit and the pit after it is occupied, capture everything in that occupied pit. Repeat across more single empty gaps when possible. An occupied Quan is worth 10 points.
    4. Finish a turn when the next pit is an occupied Quan, an empty Quan, or two empty pits in a row.
    5. Refill an empty side with five captured points, one pebble per pit. If needed, borrow the missing points from the opponent; the debt is settled at the end. The game ends when both Quan pits are empty. Remaining pebbles go to the player on that side.
    The board turns to face the current player. Switch between 2D and 3D at any time without resetting the game. Use the five numbered pit buttons if a pit is difficult to tap.
